Apple___Apple_scab.cause: Fungal/Bacterial/Viral disease affecting Apple photosynthetic foliage.
treatment: Prune and destroy infected leaves with visible Apple scab to prevent spore dispersal.
Apply broad-spectrum Copper Hydroxide or Chlorothalonil fungicide.
Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation to reduce leaf wetness duration.
Improve soil drainage and avoid excessive nitrogen fertilizer application.
Apple___Apple_scab.prevention: Use certified disease-free seeds, practice 3-year crop rotation, and maintain field sanitation.
